description: This Java class 'XmlSchemaValidator' validates XML strings against an XML Schema Definition (XSD). It constructs a schema object from a schema string or file path, and provides a method to validate XML content, logging errors and exceptions.

classes.name: XmlSchemaValidator
classes.description: A validator class for XML strings against an XSD schema, with schema loading and validation logic, including error handling and logging.

methods.name: XmlSchemaValidator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the schema validator with a schema string or file path, setting up the schema object.

methods.name: buildSchemaFactory
methods.description: Creates and configures a SchemaFactory instance with security properties.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates an XML string against the loaded schema, returning error messages or empty string if valid.
